test.title: An item of clothing that is special to you

document.cue: Describe an item of clothing that is special to you.

text: The item I'd like to describe is a dark green woollen scarf that my grandmother knitted for me when I left home to study in Almaty. It's quite long, slightly uneven in places, and it has my initials sewn into one corner in white thread.

She made it during the summer before I moved, and I remember her sitting on the balcony every evening with her needles, refusing to tell me what she was making. She gave it to me at the train station, wrapped in newspaper, and told me the winters in the city would be colder than I expected.

She was right. I wear it almost every day from November to March, and it's survived two winters of walking to lectures at minus twenty. A couple of friends have tried to borrow it, but I always say no, which they find quite funny. I've also had to repair it once, after it got caught on a fence.

It's special because it reminds me of home whenever I feel a bit lonely. I've bought much more fashionable scarves since then, but none of them feel the same, because this one was made by hand specifically for me, and it took her weeks of work.
So although it isn't exactly stylish, I think I'll be wearing it for many years to come.

tips.en: Sitting on the balcony every evening with her needles lets the listener see the grandmother.
